name: Colorado Trail Day 22: Taylor Lake to Durango
gear: New Balance Hierro v8  Shadow Grey
description: First and last camp with nightmice surprisingly. My guylines have been struggling all trail and the last night is definitely the best one for them to finally fail on. Pretty uneventful day descending off the trail! Quick hitch with Bonnie who was finishing her dog walk. Maybe I'll write up some thoughts on the whole thing tomorrow.  For now I need to figure out where to stay and eat some real food
